item.title: Reeves unveils tax rises and end of two-child benefit cap after Budget - Londra Gazete
item.description: Rachel Reeves is delivering a speech in the House of Commons setting out details of her second Budget since becoming chancellor on Wednesday 26 November. The chancellor is said she has "cut the cost of living", by taking money off bills and freezing prices. Doing this "while keeping every single one" of Labour's manifesto commitments.
